deliverables.shellDirtyStateAndLabelSwap: MasterDetailExpansionShell now tracks _selectedRow + _hasSelectedRow, surfaces a public PrimaryActionLabel that resolves to UseLabel when AllowLinkOnly && row selected && !dirty, SaveAndUseLabel when ShowRowUseAction=true, else SaveLabel. CascadingValue<DetailsContext<TEntity>> wraps the render tree so consumer fields call SetDirty() from ValueChanged. New public methods NotifyRowSelected/RaiseUseRequestedAsync/ResetSelection and EffectiveRowUseAction (default MudIconButton template).
deliverables.pickOrAddDialog: New generic Dabbler.Security.Blazor.Components.Admin.Shared.PickOrAddDialog<TRow,TEntity,TLink> hosting the shell with Mode=Dialog. Forwards all slots (FilterContent/GridContent/RowUseAction/DetailsContent/LinkDataContent) and parameters. Converts OnUseRequested/OnSaveAndUseRequested into Dialog.Close(DialogResult.Ok(result)) when the consumer-supplied Func returns non-null; throws OperationCanceledException when OnSaveAndUse returns null so the shell preserves dirty state across validation failures. Pass-through DetailsContext + NotifyRowSelected for consumers wiring MudDataGrid.RowClick.
deliverables.customerPickerDialogConcrete: AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web.Components.Pages.Customers.CustomerPickerDialog wraps PickOrAddDialog<CustomerDto,CustomerDto,object>. Provides FilterContent (search box → CustomerApi.SearchAsync), GridContent (MudDataGrid wired to RowClick → NotifyRowSelected), DetailsContent (MudForm for new-customer fields). Returns the chosen/created CustomerDto via DialogResult.Data.
deliverables.orderDetailWiring: OrderDetail.razor: customer field augmented with a 'Pick customer' button (visible when IsNew && !IsReadOnly, data-testid='pick-customer-button'). Click opens CustomerPickerDialog via IDialogService.ShowAsync; on close-with-result, writes CustomerId + CustomerName onto State.Record.
deliverables.orderCreatePage: New /orders/new route (OrderCreatePage.razor) renders <OrderDetail IsNew=true>; provides an entry point for Playwright Scenario 3 testing.
deliverables.bUnitTestsAdded: 7 new tests. MasterDetailExpansionShellTests: RaiseUseRequestedAsync_InvokesOnUseRequestedCallbackWithRow, PrimaryActionLabel_AllowLinkOnly_SwapsCorrectlyWithSelectionAndDirtyState, ResetSelection_ClearsSelectionAndDirtyState. New PickOrAddDialogTests: OnUsePicked/OnSaveAndUse × {ReturningNonNull_ClosesDialogWithResult, ReturningNull_KeepsDialogOpen} = 4 tests.
deliverables.verifierIssueFixed: Minor — dirty-state reset on validation failure. Fixed by throwing OperationCanceledException from PickOrAddDialog.HandleSaveAndUseRequestedAsync when OnSaveAndUse returns null. See issue-logs/session-003.json.
